page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, with a GPU count of 0.0, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing workloads. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is classified as memory-optimized. It offers high memory density per dedicated core, which provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large memory footprints without the overhead of additional compute cores. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
